description: Reducto is a document-processing platform for parsing, extracting, splitting, classifying, and editing documents such as PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and office files. It provides cloud and enterprise deployment options for AI and workflow teams processing documents at scale.
summary: Reducto exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API at `https://platform.reducto.ai`, a hosted bearer-authenticated MCP server at `https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp`, a public docs MCP server at `https://docs.reducto.ai/mcp`, and a `reducto` CLI installed from PyPI.
